## Design

### 2026-10-10 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-10 214710](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EMj7OOJJEoRobI2cOU9tmZbKMZE2QmsM/28a379e51ec6949048b0aef781160625afa6a03d0a5c8b708326b69cf230de96.png)

**5h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 214710](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EMj7OOJJEoRobI2cOU9tmZbKMZE2QmsM/28a379e51ec6949048b0aef781160625afa6a03d0a5c8b708326b69cf230de96.png)

Architected the core hardware platform for Starbie (Yeti J.A.R.V.I.S. Edition) around the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 microcontroller. Mapped peripheral assignments to prevent GPIO bus contention: shared fast I2C bus on GPIO6 (SDA) and GPIO7 (SCL) for both the 0.96" SSD1306 OLED and GY-521 MPU-6050 6-DoF IMU; 3-wire digital audio I2S bus on GPIO8 (SCK), GPIO9 (WS), and GPIO10 (SD) for the INMP441 MEMS microphone; and dedicated GPIO lines for the passive buzzer, DHT11 climate sensor, and dual tactile buttons. Built and wired the complete multi-sheet schematic in EasyEDA Pro, adding 0.1 µF 0805 SMD ceramic decoupling capacitors on the 3.3V bus and microphone VDD rail to filter high-frequency switching noise.
